title: Keep hypotheses; negate the target
prompt: Let n be an integer. Plan a contradiction proof that if n² is divisible by 5, then n is divisible by 5. State assumptions, explain why your cases exhaust the possibilities, and close the contradiction. Write your own approach before revealing a reference.
conditions: Keep the hypothesis 5 divides n²; temporarily assume 5 does not divide n.
Justify all possible nonzero residue classes modulo 5, or another complete argument.
Derive an explicit contradiction with a retained assumption; conclude the implication.
pitfalls: Negating the hypothesis instead of the conclusion changes the obligation.
Testing finitely many integers does not cover all integers; residue classes must represent every case.
A different complete proof is valid even if it does not use this reference layout.
reference: Every integer not divisible by 5 is congruent to 1,2,3 or 4 modulo 5. Squaring gives residues 1,4,4,1, none zero. Thus 5 cannot divide n², contradicting the retained hypothesis. Discharging the temporary assumption establishes the implication.
A direct contrapositive using the same exhaustive residues is also valid. This display cannot verify whether a submitted proof meets the obligations.

title: Explain a frame-relative load
prompt: Before these instructions, RSP=RBP=4096. Execute pushq %rbp; movq %rsp,%rbp; subq $24,%rsp; movq $19,-16(%rbp). Explain both pointers, the write address and the three allocated local slots. Do not assume unwritten slots contain zero.
conditions: Apply the eight-byte decrement before the push store.
After the frame-pointer copy, hold RBP stable while RSP moves.
Compute the memory address from the stated base and displacement, and distinguish unwritten cells from known values.
pitfalls: Using final RSP as the base of an RBP-relative operand addresses another location.
A stack diagram may use a different layout; consistent addresses and effects determine correctness.
reference: PUSH stores the old 4096 at 4088 and sets RSP=4088. MOV copies 4088 to RBP. SUB sets RSP=4064 while RBP stays 4088. The local qword slots start at 4080,4072 and 4064. The final MOV writes 19 at 4088−16=4072. The other two local slots have not been initialized by this sequence.
The simulator’s eight-byte-cell model applies here. This is an explanation self-check, not a scored diagram comparison.
